bio: Patrick Goodchild Halpin (born January 18, 1953) is an American politician who served as the fifth county executive of Suffolk County, New York, from 1988 to 1991. Halpin succeeded Jim Gaughran as Chair of the Suffolk County Water Authority on December 18, 2018.
